sequencing_alternatives.label: Hold MV Northern Light at outer anchorage (+90min)

sequencing_alternatives.label: Accelerate MV Horizon Scout departure (−3h)

sequencing_alternatives.cascade_impact: Terminal must accelerate crane gang — likely overtime. Shipping line cargo cut-off advanced by 3h.

sequencing_alternatives.label: Reassign MV Northern Light to Berth 2
